Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mountain Trek Outdoor Equipment Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality camping and outdoor gear, including tents, backpacks, hiking boots, and accessories. Our knowledgeable staff provides expert advice to customers, ensuring they find the right products for their outdoor adventures. We maintain a secure store environment with a monitored alarm system and employ loss prevention measures, including surveillance cameras. Additionally, we uphold rigorous safety protocols, regularly inspecting our premises to prevent slip-and-fall hazards. Our commitment to customer safety and product quality positions us as a trusted resource for outdoor enthusiasts.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a theft incident occurred where three high-value backpacks were stolen from the store during business hours. The loss amount was estimated at $1,200. The incident was reported to the local police, and a claim was submitted to our previous insurer for recovery. As of today, the claim is still pending with the insurance company.
